subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as optional `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool, or require a different model-facing append API before this data-loss fix lands?
rationale: The implementation is technically plausible and default-preserving, but it expands the model-facing tool contract and backend write operation contract, which is an API/product choice rather than a deterministic cleanup decision.

options.title: Accept append flag after final checks
options.body: Approve `append?: boolean` on `write` as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land after exact-head CI and owner review are clean.

options.title: Request a dedicated append tool
options.body: Ask for a separate model-facing append tool or mode-style API if maintainers want stronger semantic separation from destructive overwrite.

options.title: Defer to a narrower successor only if proven
options.body: Keep this PR open unless a narrower replacement is merged or clearly proves the same behavior with a safer review surface.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag after final checks
recommendation.body: Approve `append?: boolean` on `write` as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land after exact-head CI and owner review are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the agent-runtime, write-tool, and gateway/session boundaries affected by the API-shape decision.
